features.default_selection: branding `default_image`, then the catalog's; else you must pick
features.validated_fields: hostname, username, passphrase, filesystem with composefs
features.requirements_check: holds Next; override for RAM and CPU
features.connectivity_check: blocks on welcome and confirm, not for a copy of this computer's system; image registry first; Network settings action
features.locale_pages: pickers on welcome; listed on confirm; checked by fisherman validate
features.cancel_install: Cancel button, asks first; cancelled page
features.translatable: strings marked (qsTr, tr); template `i18n/tuna-installer-kde.ts`, kept current by a check; no translation ships (#300)
features.source_check: confirm step, Selected image card; a blocked source holds Install
features.bootc_store_view: yes, on the confirm step; the system that this computer runs is a second install source there (experimental, never the default, never on live media)
features.source_reuse_progress: yes: a label under the step line; the bar is indeterminate until the first step; the cancel dialog says that the disk does not change
features.done_receipt: yes: install ID and first-boot check, or the reason
features.recovery_key_not_in_log: yes (log file and clipboard copy redacted)
